verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents its own path for importing existing subscriptions, either server-side or client-side, by sending Apple receipts and purchase tokens to the POST /receipts endpoint. That covers bringing in live store-based subscriptions. Missing for 10: spreadsheet/CSV bulk import, migration from a competing billing platform, PCI-compliant card data transfer, documented assurance of a seamless no-customer-impact cutover, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate live subscriptions in from a spreadsheet or a competing platform — including PCI-compliant card data transfer — without customers noticing

citations.quote: Importing existing purchase data to RevenueCat can be done server-side, or client-side.
A server side import involves sending all of the Apple receipts and/or purchase tokens to RevenueCat via the `POST /receipts` REST API endpoint.
